name: ceo_briefing
description: Tiny orientation for the operator. Returns caller role, current focus, recent projects, at most two urgent spoken lines, building mode. Built from live GitHub plus a small static org pack. Do not invent PRs. Do not dump the org vault.

request_body_schema.description: Empty object is fine. Auth is the header.

required_headers_note.Authorization: Bearer <BIGBOSS_GATEWAY_SECRET> — store in ElevenLabs secrets / env_var_label BIGBOSS_GATEWAY_SECRET. Never paste a real secret into this file.
required_headers_note.x-voice-signature: Optional HMAC-SHA256 hex of the raw JSON body. Local curl uses this. EL wire uses Bearer.
